description: Build playable browser games (2D canvas or 3D Three.js) from natural language, with an automated screenshot verification loop the agent runs before claiming the game works — no unverifiable "should look fine" claims. Persists games in a stable workspace (games/<slug>/, not /tmp), iterates via targeted edits, publishes to https://jerithai.com/games/<slug>/ via the existing nginx + Cloudflare tunnel. Reuses the full 3D pattern library from the original build-game skill and adds 2D canvas, genre-appropriate engine choice, and verify-before-deliver as a hard gate.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
